info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Stibnite Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Stibnite Battery Detail Management API facilitates the submission and management of detailed information regarding Stibnite batteries. This endpoint allows authorized users to create comprehensive catalog entries that include specifications, features, and other relevant data about the batteries. Typical consumers of this API include inventory managers, sales teams, and system integrators looking to maintain an up-to-date catalog. By utilizing this API, organizations can ensure accurate product representation and streamline their operational workflows.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create detailed information about the Stibnite Battery. It is designed for developers seeking to add battery specifications, performance metrics, or any relevant data that enhances the understanding and usability of the battery.
